channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: A timeline of former Prince Andrew's ties to Jeffrey Epstein, from the Virginia Giuffre lawsuit to his 2026 arrest
item.description: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor was arrested on Thursday on suspicion of misconduct in public office. Here's a timeline of his ties to Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Former Prince Andrew released after arrest that followed fresh scrutiny over Epstein ties
item.description: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor was arrested on Thursday morning and released later that evening.

item.title: Meta's metaverse is going mobile — and leaving VR behind
item.description: Meta's Horizon Worlds pivots to mobile focus, scaling back VR efforts. This strategic shift positions it against platforms like Roblox and Fortnite.

item.title: Mark Cuban on 2 types of AI users: you're either using it to 'learn everything' or 'so you don't have to learn anything'
item.description: Bill Gurley, a partner at the Silicon Valley venture capitalist firm Benchmark, agrees "100%" with Mark Cuban that there are two types of AI users.

item.title: OpenAI offers $15,000 and support resources to staff affected by US immigration authorities
item.description: OpenAI confirmed it's offering resources to staff navigating ICE detention or other immigration issues, including $15,000 in reimbursement of legal fees.

item.title: Tesla is dropping a bargain version of the Cybertruck
item.description: Elon Musk's Tesla is doubling down on its roadmap to make the Cybertruck a working man's car.

item.title: The robotaxi industry's New York dreams just got pushed further away
item.description: New York's governor dropped a proposal to allow unmanned robotaxis, days after Waymo raised $16 billion to fund its expansion to more cities in the US.

item.title: DeepMind's CEO says using AI can make you a genius — or hurt your critical thinking skills
item.description: The DeepMind CEO said that AI is like the internet — people can use it to learn all kinds of topics, or use it in ways that "degrade" their thinking.

item.title: The newest villain in 'Toy Story' isn't a toy — it's screen time
item.description: The official trailer for "Toy Story 5" shows the toys vying for Bonnie's attention against a frog-themed tablet named Lilypad.

item.title: Trump says he's declassifying files about aliens and UFOs. That's going to make some longtime betters on Polymarket very rich.
item.description: Trump says he'll release UFO files. Alien bettors on Polymarket have been wagering millions on government confirmation.
